definitions.gloss: evil cult; heretical religion; false teaching
definitions.explanation: A religion or cult regarded as wicked, false, or harmful. Used to condemn beliefs seen as dangerous, immoral, or deceptive, often in contrast to an orthodox faith.

examples.japanese: {邪教|じゃきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
examples.english: To believe in an evil cult.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{邪教|じゃきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支配|しはい}→支配：01421_shihai⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That village was controlled by an evil cult.

examples.japanese: {邪教|じゃきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教|おし}え→教え：01909_oshie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{惑|まど}わされる→惑わす：28047_madowasu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}たない。
examples.english: There is no end to the people who are led astray by the teachings of the evil cult.

notes:
Composed of {邪|じゃ} (wicked, evil) + {教|きょう} (teaching, religion). A strongly judgmental term used to denounce a religion or sect as false or harmful; it is the opposite of {正教|せいきょう} (orthodox faith).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {邪教|じゃきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}める→広める：02405_hiromeru⟧: to spread a heretical religion
- {邪教|じゃきょう}⟦{集団|しゅうだん}→集団：03211_shuudan⟧: a cult group
- {邪教|じゃきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はまる: to fall into an evil cult

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{宗教|しゅうきょう}→宗教：03208_shuukyou⟧: religion — neutral, general term
- ⟦カルト→カルト：12829_karuto⟧: cult — modern loanword with a similar negative nuance
